FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Got questions? We have answers. Find quick help below.

q1.question: Is there a free trial or plan available?
q1.answer: Yes! The Free Plan gives you access to select open courses, basic quizzes, and standard forum support. No credit card is required to sign up.

q2.question: How does the AI Tutor help me study?
q2.answer: The AI Tutor is available 24/7. It explains complex topics, generates mock practice tests, helps plan your weekly schedule, and summarizes long lecture chapters automatically.

q3.question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
q3.answer: Absolutely. You can cancel, upgrade, or downgrade your plan directly from your account billing settings at any time without extra fees.

q4.question: Are the courses aligned with the school curriculum?
q4.answer: Yes, our experienced instructors design courses specifically to align with official school stages (Primary, Preparatory, and Secondary) and standards.
